source.label: AOI shapefiles inside the Zenodo UAV archives listed by FoMo-Bench (Woody: Pinus/Ulex/Acacia, Spekboom, Waititu) + Cactus study area
source.method: centroid of each labelled orthomosaic's AOI polygon, read from the zips via HTTP range requests; Cactus (Kaggle, no georeference) as one approximate study-area point

note: Sites per dataset: {'cactus': 1, 'woody/pinus': 4, 'woody/ulex': 4, 'woody/acacia': 2, 'spekboom': 31, 'waititu': 3}. Each AOI is a UAV plot of ~0.01-1 km2; the Cactus point is the Tehuacan-Cuicatlan reserve centre, not a measured location.
